cond_0001.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Major duties for this position include, but are not limited to:
Conduct and validate hypothesis or model testing using programming languages and mathematical and statistical processes to answer important questions from vast sets of structured and unstructured data. Plan, coordinate, and execute complex and innovative studies using advanced data modeling techniques and procedures, data trend analysis, and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms. Develops a well-rounded ML model with reinforcement learning, semi-supervised learning, deep learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), etc. Gather and process data from multiple sources and applies ML predictive analytics, and sentiment analysis to extract critical information from the collected data sets. Test models to evaluate performance, identify potential areas of weakness, and mitigate vulnerabilities. Organize, manage, and update databases for Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered systems for optimal access, filtering, and retrieval of stored data. Transform raw data into key metrics, charts, and reports and present them in formats for high-ranking government officials and key stakeholders to make consequential operational decisions. Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities to incorporate new technology or techniques and to maximize the impact on current projects. Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must be at least 16 years old.
Must be a U.S. Citizen.
Candidate required to obtain the necessary security/investigation level.
Requires a probationary period if the requirement has not been met.
Applicants must have 52 weeks of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level GS-13 in the Federal Service.
Qualifying specialized experience for GS-14 includes: Applying technical or policy knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) generative models and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms.
Experience using data analytics, modeling, and data mining to validate data sources, establish testing, and implement projects with new approaches.
Basic Requirements for one of the following series: 0800 Engineering, 1515 Operations Research, 1529 Mathematical Statistics, 1530 Statistics, 1550 Computer Science, or 1560 Data Science.
Preferred Requirements
Experience using theories, techniques, and methods of mathematical, statistical, computer, and/or data science to serve as a technical advisor.
Experience defining objectives and goals and formulating/tracking measures of success.
Education
Any applicant falsely claiming an academic degree from an accredited school will be subject to actions ranging from disqualification from federal employment to removal from federal service. If your education was completed at a foreign college or university, you must show comparability to education received in accredited educational institutions in the United States and comparability to applicable minimum course work requirements for this position.

If the duty location is outside the [Location masked] metropolitan area, the position will be included in the NCFLL bargaining unit.

cond_0030.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0030.responsibilities:
Major duties for this position include, but are not limited to:
Conduct and validate hypothesis or model testing using programming languages and mathematical and statistical processes to answer important questions from vast sets of structured and unstructured data. Plan, coordinate, and execute complex and innovative studies using advanced data modeling techniques and procedures, data trend analysis, and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms. Develops a well-rounded ML model with reinforcement learning, semi-supervised learning, deep learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), etc. Gather and process data from multiple sources and applies ML predictive analytics, and sentiment analysis to extract critical information from the collected data sets. Test models to evaluate performance, identify potential areas of weakness, and mitigate vulnerabilities. Organize, manage, and update databases for Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered systems for optimal access, filtering, and retrieval of stored data. Transform raw data into key metrics, charts, and reports and present them in formats for high-ranking government officials and key stakeholders to make consequential operational decisions. Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities to incorporate new technology or techniques and to maximize the impact on current projects. Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0030.requirements:
Must be at least 16 years old. Must be a U.S. Citizen. Candidate required to obtain the necessary security/investigation level. Requires a probationary period if the requirement has not been met.
You must meet the Basic Requirements and the Specialized Experience to qualify for this position, as described below.
Basic Requirements for 0800 Engineering Series. Basic Requirements for 1515 Operations Research Series. Basic Requirements for 1529 Mathematical Statistics Series. Basic Requirements for 1530 Statistics Series. Basic Requirements for 1550 Computer Science Series. Basic Requirements for 1560 Data Science Series.
Applicants should have around 52 weeks of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level GS-13 in the Federal Service, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Specialized Experience is the experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSAs) to perform the duties of the position successfully, and that is typically in or related to the position to be filled. To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level.
Qualifying specialized experience for GS-14 includes:
Working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) generative models and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, whether through technical or policy contexts. Experience with theories, techniques, and methods of mathematical, statistical, computer, and/or data science to serve as a technical advisor. Familiarity with data analytics, modeling, and data mining to validate data sources, establish testing, and implement projects with new approaches. Experience defining objectives and goals and formulating/tracking measures of success.
Education
Any applicant falsely claiming an academic degree from an accredited school will be subject to actions ranging from disqualification from federal employment to removal from federal service. If your education was completed at a foreign college or university, you must show comparability to education received in accredited educational institutions in the United States and comparability to applicable minimum course work requirements for this position.
Additional information
This position is being filled through the Direct Hire Authority. Traditional rating and ranking of applications do NOT apply. The Veteran's preference does not apply.
This position is inside the bargaining unit. If the duty location is within the [Location masked] metropolitan area, the position will be included in the Local 12, AFGE bargaining unit. If the duty location is outside the [Location masked] metropolitan area, the position will be included in the NCFLL bargaining unit.
As a condition of employment, all personnel must undergo a background investigation for access to DOL facilities, systems, information and/or classified materials before they can enter on duty.
Based on agency needs, additional positions may be filled using this vacancy.
[Company name masked] may use certain incentives and hiring flexibilities, currently offered by the Federal government to attract highly qualified candidates.
The Fair Chance Act (FCA) prohibits Federal agencies from requesting an applicant's criminal history information before the agency makes a conditional offer of employment. If you believe a DOL employee has violated your rights under the FCA, you may file a complaint of the alleged violation following our agency's complaint process.

cond_0149.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role. Most people become stronger in this kind of data science work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0149.responsibilities:
Major duties for this position include, but are not limited to:
Conduct and validate hypothesis or model testing using programming languages and mathematical and statistical processes to answer important questions from vast sets of structured and unstructured data. Plan, coordinate, and execute complex and innovative studies using advanced data modeling techniques and procedures, data trend analysis, and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms. Develops a well-rounded ML model with reinforcement learning, semi-supervised learning, deep learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), etc. Gather and process data from multiple sources and applies ML predictive analytics, and sentiment analysis to extract critical information from the collected data sets. Test models to evaluate performance, identify potential areas of weakness, and mitigate vulnerabilities. Organize, manage, and update databases for Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered systems for optimal access, filtering, and retrieval of stored data. Transform raw data into key metrics, charts, and reports and present them in formats for high-ranking government officials and key stakeholders to make consequential operational decisions. Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities to incorporate new technology or techniques and to maximize the impact on current projects. Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0149.requirements:

Must be at least 16 years old.
Must be a U.S. Citizen.
Candidate required to obtain the necessary security/investigation level.
Requires a probationary period if the requirement has not been met.

Qualifying specialized experience for GS-14 includes: Applying technical or policy knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) generative models and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms.
Experience using theories, techniques, and methods of mathematical, statistical, computer, and/or data science to serve as a technical advisor.
Must meet the Basic Requirements for one of the following series: 0800 Engineering, 1515 Operations Research, 1529 Mathematical Statistics, 1530 Statistics, 1550 Computer Science, or 1560 Data Science.

Experience using data analytics, modeling, and data mining to validate data sources, establish testing, and implement projects with new approaches.

Conduct and validate hypothesis or model testing using programming languages and mathematical and statistical processes to answer important questions from vast sets of structured and unstructured data. Plan, coordinate, and execute complex and innovative studies using advanced data modeling techniques and procedures, data trend analysis, and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms. Develops a well-rounded ML model with reinforcement learning, semi-supervised learning, deep learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), etc. Gather and process data from multiple sources and applies ML predictive analytics, and sentiment analysis to extract critical information from the collected data sets. Test models to evaluate performance, identify potential areas of weakness, and mitigate vulnerabilities. Organize, manage, and update databases for Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered systems for optimal access, filtering, and retrieval of stored data. Transform raw data into key metrics, charts, and reports and present them in formats for high-ranking government officials and key stakeholders to make consequential operational decisions. Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities to incorporate new technology or techniques and to maximize the impact on current projects. Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0226.requirements:

Basic Requirements for 1515 Operations Research Series. Basic Requirements For 1529 Mathematical Statistics Series. Basic Requirements for 1530 Statistics Series. Basic Requirements For 1550 Computer Science Series. Basic Requirements for 1560 Data Science Series. Applicants must have 52 weeks of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level GS-13 in the Federal Service. Qualifying specialized experience for GS-14 includes: Applying technical or policy knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) generative models and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms. Experience using theories, techniques, and methods of mathematical, statistical, computer, and/or data science to serve as a technical advisor. cond_0255.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
cond_0255.responsibilities:
Major duties for this position include, but are not limited to:
Conduct and validate hypothesis or model testing using programming languages and mathematical and statistical processes to answer important questions from vast sets of structured and unstructured data. Plan, coordinate, and execute complex and innovative studies using advanced data modeling techniques and procedures, data trend analysis, and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms. Develops a well-rounded ML model with reinforcement learning, semi-supervised learning, deep learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), etc. Gather and process data from multiple sources and applies ML predictive analytics, and sentiment analysis to extract critical information from the collected data sets. Test models to evaluate performance, identify potential areas of weakness, and mitigate vulnerabilities. Organize, manage, and update databases for Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered systems for optimal access, filtering, and retrieval of stored data. Transform raw data into key metrics, charts, and reports and present them in formats for high-ranking government officials and key stakeholders to make consequential operational decisions. Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities to incorporate new technology or techniques and to maximize the impact on current projects. Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0255.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must be at least 16 years old.
Must be a U.S. Citizen.
Candidate required to obtain the necessary security/investigation level.
Requires a probationary period if the requirement has not been met.
Around 52 weeks of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level GS-13 in the Federal Service, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Specialized experience is experience that equipped the applicant with the knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSAs) to perform the duties of the position, typically in or related to the position to be filled.
Working knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) generative models and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms, whether through technical or policy contexts.
Some background in theories, techniques, and methods of mathematical, statistical, computer, and/or data science, with comfort serving in a technical advisory capacity.
Familiarity with basic requirements for one or more of the following series: 0800 Engineering, 1515 Operations Research, 1529 Mathematical Statistics, 1530 Statistics, 1550 Computer Science, or 1560 Data Science.
Preferred Requirements
Experience using data analytics, modeling, and data mining to validate data sources, establish testing, and implement projects with new approaches.
Experience defining objectives and goals and formulating or tracking measures of success.

Coordinate with team members to conduct and validate hypothesis or model testing using programming languages and mathematical and statistical processes to answer important questions from vast sets of structured and unstructured data. Work alongside colleagues to plan, coordinate, and execute complex and innovative studies using advanced data modeling techniques and procedures, data trend analysis, and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms. Collaborate to develop a well-rounded ML model with reinforcement learning, semi-supervised learning, deep learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), etc. Gather and process data from multiple sources and, together with the team, apply ML predictive analytics and sentiment analysis to extract critical information from the collected data sets. Share findings on model performance, identify potential areas of weakness, and work with others to mitigate vulnerabilities. Coordinate the organization, management, and updating of databases for Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered systems for optimal access, filtering, and retrieval of stored data. Transform raw data into key metrics, charts, and reports and present them in formats that support high-ranking government officials and key stakeholders in making consequential operational decisions. Work with team members to identify opportunities to incorporate new technology or techniques and to maximize the impact on current projects. Performs other duties as assigned.
cond_0306.requirements:
Must be at least 16 years old. Must be a U.S. Citizen. Candidate required to obtain the necessary security/investigation level. Requires a probationary period if the requirement has not been met. You must meet the Basic Requirements and the Specialized Experience to qualify for Data Scientist - Interdisciplinary, as described below. Basic Requirements For 0800 Engineering Series. Basic Requirements for 1515 Operations Research Series. Basic Requirements For 1529 Mathematical Statistics Series. Basic Requirements for 1530 Statistics Series. Basic Requirements For 1550 Computer Science Series. Basic Requirements for 1560 Data Science Series. Applicants must have 52 weeks of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level GS-13 in the Federal Service. Specialized Experience is the experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSA's) to perform the duties of the position successfully, and that is typically in or related to the position to be filled. To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level. Qualifying specialized experience for GS-14 includes: Applying technical or policy knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) generative models and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms. Experience using theories, techniques, and methods of mathematical, statistical, computer, and/or data science to serve as a technical advisor. Experience using data analytics, modeling, and data mining to validate data sources, establish testing, and implement projects with new approaches. Experience defining objectives and goals and formulating/tracking measures of success.
